Interface CLIAbstract

All Known Implementing Classes:
CLIApp
public interface CLIAbstract
Interface defining the rendering methods for the Command Line Interface (CLI). Each method corresponds to a specific game phase, allowing the CLI to update its textual output according to the current game state.
